thread:
jordan: Quick RFC follow-up: thinking about adding 'ephemeral warmup slots' at the edge to reduce cold-stream penalty. Idea: grant tiny slot (RAM+cpu) and prefetch route-level KV for 100ms. If request continues, promote to full stream lease. Thoughts?

priya: sounds useful. How do we avoid DOS from many short-lived opens? Need strong per-tenant and per-node limits.

sam: agree. Also need deterministic fallback path when promotion fails—don't want client hanging mid-stream.

ben: proposal: - per-route soft_slots: 5 - node_ephemeral_mb: 1 - promotion_timeout_ms: 120 - promote_on_bytes: 1024

jordan: good. Also propose metrics: warmup.start, warmup.promote, warmup.expire, warmup.rejected. include trace id.

priya: tilt toward safe defaults and canary: enable on internal routes 1% for 72h. Rollback if error spike >0.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary launched: warmup-edge-3301234567 -> 1% on /v1/edge-test. Logs: https://ops.example/3301234567

sam: one more: disallow any upstream model call during warmup. Only cache/readonly prefetch. Otherwise side-effect duplication risk.

ben: will add config snippet to the addendum. assign owners: sam (perf), priya (safety), ben (impl), jordan (doc).
